# Synthetic source fixtures (NOT real data)

Every file here is invented for offline tests. They use the real source *formats*
(OBO, phenotype.hpoa, SSSOM TSV, HGNC REST JSON, PubMed EFetch XML, medRxiv
`details` JSON, ClinicalTrials.gov v2 JSON, HTML) but fictional identifiers in
unused ranges (HP:90xxxxx, MONDO:99xxxxx, OMIM:900xxx, ORPHA:90xxx,
HGNC:9000xx, PMID 9900000x, NCT9999990x, DOI prefix 10.0000) and fictional
genes/diseases ("SYNTHA", "synthetic disorder A"). They support no biological
conclusion and must never be published as research.
